description: This file defines a Java interface named ReportMailingJobRepository that extends Spring Data JPA repository interfaces for managing ReportMailingJob entities. It includes a custom method to find active and non-deleted report mailing jobs.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for ReportMailingJob entities, including a custom finder method for active and not deleted jobs.

methods.name: findByIsActiveTrueAndIsDeletedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all ReportMailingJob instances where isActive is true and isDeleted is false.
